summary: Reviewed tests/integration.test.ts — 17 tests covering all 5 ACs. Clean structure, correct assertions, follows established test patterns. No blocking issues found.
captureOutput() helper correctly spies on process.stdout.write / process.stderr.write and restores via afterEach vi.restoreAllMocks() — lifecycle is sound.
validateCommandKeys error message format cross-checked: error includes both cmd.id and cmd.key, so regex assertions /ab/ and /bad-key/ are correct.

workspaceRoot set to '/tmp/integration' is consistent with pre-existing test fixtures (create-menu.test.ts, menu/interactive.test.ts use '/tmp/test') and is never accessed at runtime in these tests — acceptable.
No Fix-Forward or Blocking changes required.

comments.note: makeIntegrationConfig() factory with Partial<MenuConfig> overrides is a clean, composable pattern — consistent with create-menu.test.ts. Good reuse of established conventions.
captureOutput() returns named arrays (stdout, stderr) plus a combined() helper. Clear API, avoids global mutable state, plays well with vi.restoreAllMocks().

AC4 covers four cases: multi-char key throws with key text in message, multi-char key throws with command id in message, valid single-char key does not throw, null key does not throw. Comprehensive edge-case coverage for S5.
AC5 pre-flight suite covers custom exitCode, default exitCode fallback, stderr message content, and dispatch suppression — all four observable behaviors are independently verified.
